## Décompte inbox (Phase 3)
Unread mail from an allowed sender → each .xlsx/.pdf/.jpg/.png goes to the local AI Controller API → phone alert with the review link (PIN required). Errors send a "not processed" alert. Setup: docs/phase3-automation-guide.md
